description: Photograph depicting a wide, natural river flowing through a green, semi-natural landscape. The river surface is calm, reflecting the partly cloudy sky and the dense, dark green deciduous trees lining the far bank. In the foreground, the riverbank is covered with lush green grass and reeds, with some lighter-coloured seed heads visible. Distant hills, also covered in vegetation, are visible under the blue sky in the background. This image exemplifies a natural or semi-natural watercourse, likely with a width greater than 10 metres and with un- or less vegetated river beds, as described in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) documentation for land cover classification.
